raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Description

Fix the first AWEX weight update in the Ascend Geometry3K test, where Qwen3.5-0.8B's tied output head was omitted from inference parameters. Pin AWEX to `2bff8835beb287ca853a52d463b697a0e3da3e81` in both A2 and A3 images; this preserves tied-weight aliases in the Qwen3.5 vLLM parameter iterator.

Enable AWEX with NPU/HCCL settings in the Geometry3K config, retain bridge-based export configuration, reduce graph capture sizes to `[4, 8, 16]`, and remove the explicit GDN prefill backend override.

## Related Issue

None.

## Type of Change

- [x] 🐛 Bug fix

## Checklist

- [ ] I have read the [Contributing Guide](https://github.com/areal-project/community/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] Pre-commit hooks pass (`pre-commit run --all-files`)
- [ ] Relevant tests pass; new tests added for new functionality
- [ ] Documentation updated (if applicable; built with `./docs/build_all.sh`)
- [ ] Branch is up to date with `main`
- [ ] Self-reviewed via `/review-pr` command
- [x] This PR was created by a coding agent via `/create-pr`
- [ ] This PR is a breaking change

**Breaking Change Details (if applicable):** None.

## Additional Context

Targets `ascend`. Scoped commit hooks and whitespace checks pass. Full pre-commit checks encounter a read-only uv cache during lockfile regeneration; remaining hooks pass. The earlier CI run failed with `train=426 infer=425 missing_on_infer=[lm_head.weight]`. Updated A2/A3 image builds and the two-step NPU test have not been run for this pin change. CI consumes the prebuilt `a3-nightly` image, so the updated AWEX pin must be included in that image before a rerun can validate the fix.

detail.body:
## Description

Fix the first AWEX weight update in the Ascend Geometry3K test, where Qwen3.5-0.8B's tied output head was omitted from inference parameters. Pin AWEX to `2bff8835beb287ca853a52d463b697a0e3da3e81` in both A2 and A3 images; this preserves tied-weight aliases in the Qwen3.5 vLLM parameter iterator.

Enable AWEX with NPU/HCCL settings in the Geometry3K config, retain bridge-based export configuration, reduce graph capture sizes to `[4, 8, 16]`, and remove the explicit GDN prefill backend override.

## Related Issue

None.

## Type of Change

- [x] 🐛 Bug fix

## Checklist

- [ ] I have read the [Contributing Guide](https://github.com/areal-project/community/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] Pre-commit hooks pass (`pre-commit run --all-files`)
- [ ] Relevant tests pass; new tests added for new functionality
- [ ] Documentation updated (if applicable; built with `./docs/build_all.sh`)
- [ ] Branch is up to date with `main`
- [ ] Self-reviewed via `/review-pr` command
- [x] This PR was created by a coding agent via `/create-pr`
- [ ] This PR is a breaking change

**Breaking Change Details (if applicable):** None.

## Additional Context

Targets `ascend`. Scoped commit hooks and whitespace checks pass. Full pre-commit checks encounter a read-only uv cache during lockfile regeneration; remaining hooks pass. The earlier CI run failed with `train=426 infer=425 missing_on_infer=[lm_head.weight]`. Updated A2/A3 image builds and the two-step NPU test have not been run for this pin change. CI consumes the prebuilt `a3-nightly` image, so the updated AWEX pin must be included in that image before a rerun can validate the fix.
